time.title: Newest change in the slideshow, as seconds from unix epoch
time.description: The newest of the slideshow's own update time and its articles' publish times. The channel server reads this as the payload's latestContent. Always present.

articles.title: The slideshow's intranet news articles, in the order Hager shows them
articles.description: One slide per article. Can be empty when nothing is published in the slideshow; a display then has nothing to show.

teaser.title: Short introduction to the article, as plain text, null when there is none
teaser.description: Can be a few sentences long; displays should clamp it rather than shrink the text.

image.title: URL of the article's image, null when it has none
image.description: Points to live.hager.com with a signed media_token query parameter; use the URL as is.

publishedAt.title: Publish time as seconds from unix epoch, null when unknown

language.title: Article's language as a locale with an underscore, e.g. fr_FR, null when unknown
language.description: Displays use it to format dates in the article's own language (fr_FR → fr-FR).

settings.title: Display settings Hager has chosen for the slideshow in Staffbase Studio
settings.description: Displays follow these instead of their own palette and timing, so the screens look as Hager configured them.

layout.title: Orientation the slideshow was designed for
layout.description: Staffbase's value verbatim. LANDSCAPE is the only value seen so far; displays should lay out by their actual size and treat this as a hint.

fillImage.title: Whether article images fill their area (cropping) instead of fitting inside it

backgroundColor.title: Slide background color as #rrggbb, null when not set

logo.title: URL of Hager's logo to show on every slide, null when there is none
logo.description: Points to live.hager.com with a signed media_token query parameter; use the URL as is.

showDateTime.title: Whether to show the current date and time on the slides
